role: Predeclared same-domain multi-series historical evaluation following exploratory CONUS results; not prospective, not cross-domain, not independent states
target: Official USDM state-level DSCI, current archive snapshot
numeric_selection: Train-only calibration selects ridge alpha and each DLinear seed epoch. Refit on train+calibration for the selected epoch; choose calibration winner using train-only calibration predictions. No decision/test refit.
feedback: A prior complete target is released only if prior origin + horizon <= current origin, using true weekly indices
transfer_scope: Transfer round15 selection algorithm with exactly three declared candidates, not CONUS weights; fit each state separately. Candidate pool differs from round15 five-candidate comparison.
publication_audit: Inspect all previously saved 351 official XML files and their headers; fetch six deterministically spaced archive files for current-byte comparison. Unchanged bytes across today snapshots do not prove original publication or immutable history.
strict_text_mode: No verified per-document first-publication evidence -> numeric-only. No narrative fusion in this round.
freeze: Register protocol before first state-data download; save all six selection seals before scoring any test targets. No region/rule/parameter substitutions based on evaluation.
aggregate: Report all six state-horizon results, per-state scaled MSE, raw DSCI RMSE, seed spread, win counts and equal-task mean relative gain; three states and two overlapping horizons are not six independent replications.
output_policy: All files on D drive. Preserve rounds 13-15. Push accepted code and compact results only to own branch; record live remote proof, not stale tracking refs.
